reviews.author: Kassidy Baldwin
reviews.text: Went to get my car fixed and had a great experience! Very affordable, thorough, and they do excellent work. The entire staff is friendly, professional, and clearly well-trained. Matt himself is extremely knowledgeable and truly cares about his customers. If you call with something that needs to be looked at ASAP, he does his best to fit you in the same day or the next. Couldn’t have asked for better service, definitely will be coming back. Highly recommend this shop!

reviews.author: Jimmy Singletary
reviews.text: C&S Automotive They're very professional, courteous, they will never take advantage of anyone, straight forward with their diagnosis. I've been going to them from the start. Never had any issues and are reasonably priced. I'm very satisfied with their work! So if you're looking for a mechanic shop in the Moncks Corner area I would highly recommend them and ladies you don't have to worry about them taking advantage of you. Remember C&S AUTOMOTIVE FOR ALL YOUR XAR CARE NEEDS!!!!

reviews.author: NH2
reviews.text: My water pump went out right across the street from these guys and I gave them a shot. Matt checked out the issue and diagnosed it within minutes. I was nervous what the charge would be knowing I’m in a desperate situation and the car is not drivable. What do I get? A great price( I am aware of fair repair costs growing up in an automotive household) and amazing service. Matt ordered the parts right away and my car was fixed next day. I am very skeptical on auto shops and I now found one I know is trustworthy. I do not recommend anyone unless I’m sure of it. They killed it and I will now be using them for all repairs going forward! Bring your vehicle here and you won’t be disappointed and you won’t get ripped off! Thanks Matt!

reviews.author: Brenda Litchfield
reviews.text: Sample Appreciation Message I really appreciate the outstanding service I received at this auto shop. The owner was incredibly friendly, and the entire staff made me feel welcome from the moment I walked in. It’s clear they take pride in their work and truly care about their customers. They offer a wide range of services, and it’s reassuring to have a business in town that you can trust with your vehicle. The quality of their work and the professionalism they show make a big difference. I would highly recommend bringing your car here if you need any kind of maintenance or repair. It’s great to have a place where you know you’ll get honest, reliable, and friendly service.

reviews.author: Emily Browder
reviews.text: I heard about this place from a family member and I had a great experience with this car repair shop. They fixed my car very quickly and kept me updated on what was going on. The staff was friendly, honest, and did good quality work. I would definitely recommend them to anyone who needs fast and reliable car repairs.

reviews.author: K mccormick
reviews.text: Thank you, Matt, for going over and above for us. We were far from home, camping, and we were scheduled to head home in a couple of days. My 38' RVs engine started messing up. We were over six hours' drive from home, and the engine was barely running. I called numerous companies, and no one could help us. I kept calling, and I was finally recommended to 'C&S automotive'. I called and spoke to Matt, and he took us right in. He's such a nice man. He was very comfortable taking care of our RV. He explained everything and what to expect. His team jumped and did a lot of work. And he had us back on the road the next day RV engine working great. I'm so very appreciative of Matt and his team. It's very scary when you have problems so far away from home. We really lucked out finding such an amazing company. Highly Recommended!!!

reviews.author: Brian Pennell
reviews.text: Had my wife's Sorento towed here. The Electric Park Brake was broken. It took 2 days for them to receive the parts and they got the vehicle back to me quicker than expected. Very satisfied with the whole process and the price was fair. Will, definitely, use them again.

reviews.author: Matthew Steinhour
reviews.text: I’ve been going to C and S for a few years and I can’t think of anyone I’d rather work with. They’re kind, courteous, and professional. Most importantly to me, Matt and his team take the time to really explain the problem and problem solve with you. They’re hard working and every time I’ve dropped off a vehicle to get worked in, it’s been safe and well cared for. I highly recommend these guys.

reviews.author: paul allocco
reviews.text: Truly wanna have the better shops in the area I brought my van to multiple locations for the same persistent alignment issue tires would get bald within a month. Bring it here once fix the issue figure out the overall problem in and out within two hours.

reviews.author: Krista Hancock
reviews.text: Matt does a great job explaining everything that's going on with my car and I trust him to help me keep it running smoothly. I highly recommend C&S Automotive without hesitation. I'm definitely a repeat customer!

reviews.author: Nae Nae
reviews.text: Great service! Went to get an alignment and new tires. Matt Chubb is extremely knowledgeable. He did a great job explaining everything to me. Definitely will be returning for my car needs.

reviews.author: Terrell Mcclary
reviews.text: Dropped my car off early morning for some much needed suspension work, work was completed in a timely manner. Was missing a stud on my tires and he replaced it. Awesome customer service will definitely be back again. Satisfied customer!!!!

reviews.author: Rhonda Maples
reviews.text: I’ve been doing business here since the beginning. I watched Matt grow up and I know I can count on him and his crew to take good care of my vehicles . You get honest answers about what your vehicle needs, how long it’s going to take to fix and how much it’s going to cost. As long as they’re around, I won’t be going anywhere else.

reviews.author: Paul Greene
reviews.text: We were ready to get another car because our present car was in rough shape. We decided to get a professional opinion. Matt found the tires and air conditioner were bad. Now the car is pleasant again. We are extremely pleased with the result.

reviews.author: Samantha Maples
reviews.text: My family and I use C&S for everything from oil and tire changes to large repairs. Recently my car was dropped off and I pretty much gave some vague details of what was going on and pretty much said figure it out and let me know. Every issue with my car was diagnosed, quoted, and rectified in a timely manner.

reviews.author: David
reviews.text: Honest, hardworking, and reliable. Another shop quoted me $3600 for an “extensive, difficult repair”. C&S? $1700 and 3 days later, my car is in great shape. Huge thanks to these guys. Will be referring all my friends and family to this business. Well done gentlemen!

reviews.author: nikki
reviews.text: Highly recommend ! Was able to take us for a brake job the same day we called, very friendly and fair pricing. We will definitely return if we need anything else done!

reviews.author: Luzina
reviews.text: I discovered C&S a few months ago after another shop failed to locate parts for a steering wheel pump replacement. Matt and David stepped in, finding what was needed and fixing it within days. Since then, I’ve returned for brake work, rotor resurfacing, and an HVAC actuator replacement. It is incredibly hard to find an honest, reliable mechanic, and I am so thankful I found C&S.

reviews.author: Tina Agee
reviews.text: Always friendly. Fair and reasonable. I live in Goose Creek and always come to C&S Auto in Moncks Corner for my repairs .

reviews.author: Shirlette Benton
reviews.text: Excellent work, mat was beyond perfect and the other employees too. The prices were very reasonable as well; we look forward to our next appointment.

reviews.author: Brandy Bouie
reviews.text: Fantastic service and friendly employees. We get all of our automotive maintenance done here. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Jon R
reviews.text: Very friendly and prices are very reasonable. I have definitely found my new go-to place for automotive service.

reviews.author: Angie Seigler
reviews.text: After my car was completely misdiagnosed at another shop in town, I took it to David at C&S Automotive in Moncks Corner. He actually listened, had a good idea of the problem before even opening the hood, got me in quickly, and had it fixed within a few hours. If you want professional, fast, and truly exceptional service, I highly recommend the team at C&S. Honestly, if you’re taking your car anywhere else, you’re going to the wrong place! Thank you again C&S. You’re the BEST!

reviews.author: Kamren Curtis
reviews.text: Top quality service at a very fair rate. Any of your needs can be taken of by these professionals. Highly recommended for anything automotive.

reviews.author: Caitlin Wallace
reviews.text: A friend of ours recommended this shop and now I’ll be recommending as well! Very professional and great communication, very fair pricing!

reviews.author: Michelle McClennon
reviews.text: My service at C&S was awesome experience and the staff friendly. This was my first time here and I highly recommend that you support this local business.

reviews.author: Savannah Moore
reviews.text: C&S is one of the best mechanic shops around! Matthew is trustworthy and explains everything clearly giving honest advice. He’s been servicing my cars for years. The atmosphere is friendly and outgoing. I couldn’t recommend a more reliable mechanic who truly cares about his customers!

reviews.author: Carol Lesh
reviews.text: The guys at C and S are knowledgeable, trustworthy, and dedicated to giving the customer a good value for their money.

reviews.author: Timothy Clutter
reviews.text: This place is truly amazing. Honesty and integrity is what they are about. There workmanship is impeccable !! I’ve been coming here since they opened in 2019 and I wouldn’t take my vehicle anywhere else. If you’re in the Charleston area, I would highly recommend C & S Auto and Truck Repair. Truly, An “” AWESOMENESS “” Company !!

reviews.author: kate lynn
reviews.text: always honest, never price gouge, and always does a good thorough job. i will always bring my vehicles here.

reviews.author: paul holmes
reviews.text: Great customer service, fast and friendly down to earth employees and owner!! Knows what they are doing!!! I rate them an A+++

reviews.author: matthew
reviews.text: Quick, friendly and gives you updates as the job is being done. Great business with matt and dave every time.

reviews.author: Kambrea Lewis
reviews.text: I was driving from myrtle beach to goose creek when I started having trouble with my car. I found this shop online and stopped hoping they could help me. Matt was awesome! In less than 5 minutes he realized the problem and corrected it in under 30 minutes! He documented negligence from another company and ensured my car was safe before returning to my drive. Excellent shop and customer service!

reviews.author: Jessa Frances De La Rosa
reviews.text: A rare find - As a woman- finding a place that I know I can trust, that isn’t going to take advantage of me and is going to make sure that I am truly taken care of in the best way possible is incredibly invaluable. Profoundly grateful to have an auto shop with integrity that I can trust- thank you!!

reviews.author: Delores Love
reviews.text: I paid $30 for Matt to tell me , I have a transmission problem and he don't do transmissions. Very nice at first until he couldn't help me. Then turn on me where it was like WHEN ARE YOU COMING TO GET YOUR CAR. Ugh! I came to them because of there reviews. People beware. Terrible attitude!! And the first time I've ever paid money to be told I DON'T KNOW! I don't do transmission! Yea it showed Matt the way you were driving my car with me in it. When in doubt don't tear the car up any more, if you don't know. There was a reason I got a tow truck to bring it to you. Unbelievable!

reviews.author: coleman morrow
reviews.text: Absolutely the highest quality of work with competent mechanics you will find in Moncks corner, they took care of a few issues I had with my car. They ensure quality behind the work that they do.

reviews.author: OR_Caragoner VODS
reviews.text: Very friendly and straightforward people. They were fast and honest with me on what I needed. They didn't try to upsell me either when they had the chance and instead helped me find what I needed in my budget. Incredible people. If you need car repairs, this is the place

reviews.author: harry jones
reviews.text: Can’t brag about Matt and C & S automotive enough!! I had work done on my truck on a Wednesday at C & S and went out of town that Saturday to Charlotte. My truck had issues with what was repaired and was inoperable all the way in Charlotte. Matt took time out of schedule on that Monday and personal came to me miles away to repair my truck and get me on my way! Totally stand up business and totally great guy! I am a customer for life!

reviews.author: Doty
reviews.text: Great staff & the owner is super friendly. I mean that in a good way & he checked out my ac on my car & looks like i need a new ac clutch or a compressor but the charge to ck it out was like only $30 ,but being I need more than just freon ,he didn't charge me the $30 .Not to many mechanics will do that & my car back in October needed a new battery & he came all the way where I broke down & even though I ha e roadside assistant.they were taking forever to come tow me & the owner nit only towed my car but also dropped me at my home .Found out it was the alternator & not battery .His prices were fantastic & will keep him from here on out as my mechanic.

reviews.author: Sherri Stevenson
reviews.text: We love, C&S Automotive! I won’t take my car anywhere else. They are very honest and always willing to give us the best advice as far as repairs.

reviews.author: Mike corte
reviews.text: This place is amazing. They go out of there way to make sure you are happy. They stand by their work and parts. I would know. Matt is great as well. Need work done please go check them out.

reviews.author: steve austin Corral
reviews.text: Both of the owners a very kind and proffesional with reasonable rates. I brought my honda for service. They worked with me to find a simple solution to my problem without the "i know it all and you dont" attitude i expect from most shops. Keep up the great work guys. Ill bring the e back for service every time.

reviews.author: Joshua Rasmussen
reviews.text: They've made a lifetime customer out of me. I can you usually fix most issues that occur with my vehicles. However, my check engine light came on and it was throwing a code that I couldn't resolve on my own. I took it into them, and they could have tried to convince me to spend 70 Shop hours to change some components to MAYBE resolve the code, but instead told me that my vehicle is not at risk and it's okay to continue driving. Saved me a ton of money, and the honesty made it so that I will always choose them.

reviews.author: Renata Hale
reviews.text: After living in Summerville a year finally found a honest and good mechanic. This will be the only place I take my vehicles to! Highly recommend

reviews.author: Whitney Howard
reviews.text: Best car service in town who put their customers first. Helped me greatly today with their service but their kindness was above and beyond.

reviews.author: Jin Cuts
reviews.text: Coworker referred me here and I was not disappointed. Replaced motor mount and got my oil pressure gauge working. When I spoke to owner over the phone he knew what needed to be done to my Tahoe.

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.text: Awesome. I drive roughly a hour just to get to this location. Very efficient mechanics. C&S was recommended by word of mouth from a friend. I highly recommend as well.

reviews.author: Willie Knox
reviews.text: First time visiting the shop to have tire put on my truck The owner is a really nice guy. I will definitely be using their service again.

reviews.author: Adam Brandow
reviews.text: Matt and Dave are great at what they do. Never a bad experience when you take a vehicle to their shop.

reviews.author: Chelsea Bryant
reviews.text: The guys are super knowledgeable and reasonably priced . Highly recommend them for all my personal and business vehicles!

reviews.author: Josh Stamps
reviews.text: Have taken a car here for a few things and these guys are straightforward and hard working mechanics that are price accordingly.

reviews.author: Tina
reviews.text: They are quick, TOTALLY REASONABLY PRICED, always courteous and professional. They have a life long customer.

reviews.author: Teresa Harper
reviews.text: Matt went above and beyond and offered advice that saved me tremendously. I would trust him with any of my repairs.

reviews.author: patrick stubbs
reviews.text: Matt is very honest about telling you about what's going on with my wife's car hopefully it not messed up to bad.

reviews.author: Carter Hayes
reviews.text: C&S did an outstanding job in repairing my Avalon and Scion. They were very friendly, detailed, and clear in giving the problems and solutions. In both cases, they were able to repair for less money than anticipated. I highly recommend Matt and his team for all automotive repairs!
